meta.title: Color Wars — a local chain reaction game
meta.description: Download Color Wars: a fast chain reaction game for one to four players on one device. No account, no ads, no internet needed.

a11y.heroArtLabel: A Color Wars board with coloured orbs

hero.title: One board. Four colours. Endless cascades.
hero.subtitle: Place orbs, trigger explosions and be the last colour standing. Share one screen, play offline, and take the game wherever you go.

features.title: Easy to learn. Hard to stop.
features.subtitle: A few seconds per turn, but every move can flip the whole board.

items.title: Pass and play
items.description: Up to four players share one screen. Seats start on different sides so everyone gets a fair view of the board.

items.title: Solo against the bot
items.description: Practice alone with three difficulty levels. The hardest setting plays to win — bring your best cascades.

items.title: Set it up your way
items.description: Choose a 7×7 to 15×15 board, grow only from your own cells, rename players, change colours, and switch sound, haptics or theme.

items.title: Quiet and private
items.description: No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Matches and settings stay on your device, so you can play with no connection.

download.title: Take Color Wars with you.
download.description: Download the Android app, open the file and start a match. Nothing to sign up for.
download.note: Open the downloaded file to install. Android may ask you to allow installs from unknown sources.

footer.text: Made for quick matches and very big cascades.

errors.title: Site content could not be loaded
errors.body: Open this page from a local web server (not directly as a file) and make sure content.json is next to index.html.
